gaps.what: Any Murphy Oil ownership or contract interest in Tembikai
gaps.why: All read sources identify PETRONAS Carigali (owner) and Vestigo Petroleum (operator); none mentions Murphy. The task's premise that Tembikai is a Murphy asset is not supported.
gaps.next_action: Treat Tembikai as a technology analogue only; do not record it as a Murphy field unless a Murphy-specific source is found.
